scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend --ignore-scripts && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.install:prod: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend --ignore-scripts && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.deploy: git pull --ff-only && npm run install:prod && npm run build && pm2 restart myfolio
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
